questions_before_times: How many dogs, and how big each one is
Has any dog ever bitten or snapped at a person? (a yes sends the request to the owner first)
The yard: front, back or both; fenced or not; under or over a quarter acre
How long since the yard was last cleaned: a week, a month, or a season or more (a long time is priced from photos)
How often: every week, twice a week, every 2 weeks, or just once
How the tech gets in: an open gate, a latch, or a gate code
safety_stop: a dog that is hurt, very sick, struggling to breathe or ate something toxic, right now
a dog loose in the yard that attacks
a dog that got out of the yard and is lost right now
needles, broken glass, a dead animal, sewage or chemicals in the yard
license: Usually none: most places license neither pet waste removal nor yard cleanup. Some cities or counties ask for a business license, and some ask for a permit to haul waste away for pay. The state's or city's form says which.
staff_skills: ["Weekly and one-time yard cleanups","First big cleanups of heavy yards","Yards with nervous or protective dogs","Yard deodorizing","Video yard checks with a written plan (the planning desk)"]
messages_never: ["Gate, door, garage and alarm codes","Where a key is kept","A dog's health conditions and medicines"]
